description: The Makeup Bag Essentials Audit project is designed to provide clients with a personalized assessment of their current makeup collection. This service will involve a thorough review of the client's existing makeup products, taking into account their unique skin type, tone, and personal preferences. The expert stylist will analyze the effectiveness and suitability of each product, identifying any items that may not align with the client's needs. Following the audit, a comprehensive report will be delivered, including tailored recommendations for essential makeup products that enhance the client's natural beauty. This project aims to simplify the client's makeup routine by ensuring they have the right products that work harmoniously with their features, ultimately boosting their confidence for any occasion.
deliverables: Detailed audit report of current makeup products (document)
Personalized product recommendations based on skin type and tone (document)

Follow-up email with additional tips and product links (document)

name: Personalized Makeup Masterclass
summary: Conduct one-on-one makeup masterclasses to teach clients advanced techniques and tips for achieving their desired looks.
description: The Personalized Makeup Masterclass is designed for individuals seeking to elevate their makeup skills through tailored, one-on-one instruction. This immersive experience will cover advanced techniques, including contouring, highlighting, and color theory, ensuring clients gain a comprehensive understanding of makeup application. Each session will be customized to address the client's specific needs and desired looks, whether for everyday wear or special occasions. Participants will receive hands-on guidance, enabling them to practice techniques in real-time with expert feedback. By the end of the masterclass, clients will not only enhance their makeup skills but also build confidence in their ability to create stunning looks that reflect their personal style.
